competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that increases according to your Defense and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 30% chance. In addition, increases your Defense by 30%. (Accumulates up to 5 times)

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
DEF increases by given amount under certain conditions

competences.description: Inflicts damage on the enemy in proportion to your Defense, destroys the target's HP by the amount of damage dealt and provokes for 1 turn. Afterwards, you will be turned into a {stone_st} until the next turn starts.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: When the battle begins or if your turn ends with 70% or higher HP, you will be turned into a {stone_st} until the next turn starts. The damage dealt on allies will be reduced gradually if the ally gets attacked with multiple hits when you are turned into a statue. This does not accumulate with other damage reduction effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
